title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00126 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
10:45 - 13:15: Waited on supply boat with equipment for pulling production riser meanwhile l/o 3 1/2" DP from set-back. Meanwhile performed PMS.
13:15 - 15:00: Waited on supply boat with equipment for pulling production riser meanwhile canged handling equipment to handle 5 1/2" DP. L/o 5 1/2" DP from set-back.
15:00 - 19:00: Continued l/o 5 1/2" DP from set-back. Meanwhile removed remaining hoses and electrical cables from WH
19:00 - 19:15: Performed TBT for l/d diverter
19:15 - 20:45: R/u and attached lifting equipment to TDS and diverter. L/o diverter and secured same on main deck. Removed diverter lifting equipment from TDS. Meanwhile performed TBT for building scaffolding around BOP connector on test stump.
20:45 - 21:30: Prepared 1502 hoses/chiksan at WH built scaffolding around BOP.
21:30 - 22:15: N/u BOP nt2 connector on test stump. Prepared lifting equipment on moonpool hatch. Lifted multibowl nt2 connector to drill floor. Lifted PR cutter BHA to HTS
22:15 - 23:00: Continued n/u BOP nt2 connector on test stump
23:00 - 00:00: Removed hatch in moonpool.
